versionFieldNote: Machine-checked by extraction/verify_all.py: repositoryVersion (must equal the newest `## x.y.z` heading of CHANGELOG.md), pageSpecVersion (must equal schema/pagespec.schema.json `version`), allowlistVersion (must equal tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version), tokenCatalogVersion, tokenPolicyVersion, and the whole counts block. Documentation-only, hand-maintained, nothing verifies them: tokenVersion, sectionRegistryVersion, componentRegistryVersion, assetRegistryVersion. Versioning: patch = wording or evidence only; minor = any token, contract, budget, motion or asset-policy change; major = a PageSpec-breaking schema change (also bump pageSpecVersion). The wrapper-gate thresholds live in extraction/wrapper_gate.py and are enforced, not versioned.

sourceProject.name: Glaze landing clone (React 18, Vite 5, Tailwind 3.4)
sourceProject.description: Study clone of a real, live commercial site (Glaze by Raycast). Brand marks, copy, app icons, avatars and screenshots are not licensed for reuse; see assets/asset-roles.json. Pages built from it for another brand use PageSpec mode `generated`.

scope.deliberatelyNotModelled: The in-page 'App not found' state of /app/<unknown slug> and the search / pagination states (?q=, ?page=, ?entriesQuery=, ?entriesPage=) of /store, /store/:category and /awards: they render on routes that are modelled. /app/:slug and /blog/:slug are pattern routes.

excludedFromPackage: *.zip (design-repo.zip is a build artifact, regenerate last, never commit)

dependencies.note: Verification needs no node tooling. Install with: python3 -m pip install jsonschema. The extraction/*.mjs evidence tools (optional; they re-record routeTable, sectionHeights, typographyChecks, layoutChecks, contentBudgets and the protection lists from the source project) need node, esbuild (the source project's dev dependency) and Playwright for the browser ones.
